What FMC says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenueFourth-quarter revenue, excluding India, is expected to be in the range of $1.04 billion to $1.14 billion, essentially flat at the midpoint versus fourth-quarter 2025.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted EBITDAAdjusted EBITDA is forecasted to be in the range of $210 million to $230 million, a decline of 22 percent at the midpoint versus the prior-year period.
  • Full year 2026: free cash flowFree cash flow is expected to be in the range of negative $350 million to negative $150 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
